info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Account Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Counterparty Risk Management API enables users to retrieve detailed information about account management related to counterparty risks based on specific parameters. This endpoint is essential for financial institutions and risk assessment teams to analyze and assess the potential risks associated with counterparties. By providing targeted insights, users can make informed decisions regarding partnerships and transactions. Common use cases include evaluating client risk profiles and compliance monitoring efforts.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve detailed counterparty risk information for a specific party identified by their unique ID. It provides insights into the associated risks, helping to manage and mitigate potential exposure.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve counterparty risk information for a specific party identified by PARTY-600045. Ensure that all required parameters are included to obtain accurate data.

200.description: The request was successful and the desired resource has been retrieved.
